decision.next_stage: Proceed only to stage-4 bounded raw-capture/batch engineering validation; retain selected full-page OCR settings.
decision.capture_findings: All 16 pages completed and passed source/output/export checks. Both text columns were represented in the 16 full-page overlays and 96 bands; no whole-column dropout was observed.
decision.limits: This is not proof of no missing physical lines. Local character loss, broken surname headings, symbol pseudo-lines and detached suffixes prevent treating native lines as verified entries.
required_stage4_controls: Per-page download retry/receipt handling; keep actual retrieval aliases and hashes
Non-destructive line/page quality flags alongside every batch output
Stop or quarantine suspect column/geometry/missing-output cases for review
Keep supplementary/mixed first-page scopes and known pagination gaps explicit
Do not count residents or perform unreviewed entry concatenation from native rows
